data.name: Seed Of The Arcane , Episode 1
data.detailed_description:
****This game is on Alpha test - Please Read the Early Access Description before buying*****

Seed of the Arcane is an open world, action role play game, set in the fantasy world of Magion Islands, where magic and steel determine the future

Explore the world of Magion Islands though the eyes of a commoner, who is losing everything as the world shatter around him. Don’t give up. Become stronger. Forge alliances and together with your party change the destiny of the islands forever.

After all, prophecies can be falsified as a man without future, is a page without letters. Letters can forge a great story of victory or defeat

Seed of the Arcane is a story driven game and as such it is contains a lot of world lore and many stories.It is recommended for people that playing
rpg for their Role Playing aspect and their story-line.

Features:
  • 3 Different endings
  • Start with Nameless, and then experience 5 different playable characters.
    (More Specifically in the middle of the 4th level of the game the player will change from the main character ,
    to other playable characters to experience the story from their eyes)
  • 9 Different Npcs that you could play with and experience their story
  • Almost all the choices matter and their not easily forgiven
  • 4-5 Different and unique levels according the chooses that you have made
  • 30+ different creatures
  • 100+ Quests and sub quests
  • Crafting System
  • Day and night circle that effects the Npcs movements
  • 5 Different mini games
  • Combat Styles depending on your weapon of choose
  • Interactive Npcs that behave according to your chooses

3 edits after first review are included

11/27/17

So I had to check it out since it's new 0.5 GAME CHANGING UPDATE, which in fact was game changing, the begining changed, and all the broken elements vanish... but so many new ones are here! It is the same copy paste assest, including RAPTORS! love it.

I don't need to go into more, but its the same horrible game put together differently... Same voice actors that cover all voices, no emotion monotone people who are electronically pitch adjust so bad... 

I do not need to say more here is the video,
Which the Dev will downvote.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=faOL1Yb6jaM


---

Edit : 6/5/17
More problems with the Dev contacting me, and in an attempt to make it stop, this is the first part of the game AGAIN, but without the movement problem, And unless he makes a MIND BLOWING GAME CHANGING WISH GRANTING, update, I will not be touching this game again.
 If you survive this video , it will highlight some of the most broken things this game has to offer on its basic functions.
https://youtu.be/pTB79574AaQ

---

Edit: 5/31/17
Quoting from the last video "time will tell who is right"
The Dev has shown me nothing besides disrespect for providing an honest review. you want good reviews, then release a HALF DECENT product. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FFhRBgISYWs

Here is another hour of gameplay to show you this game is not fit to be sold, As the Dev continues to downvote with multiple accounts and even pretends to be players of this game. The movement issue is fixed and was able to be played normally

As you can see the Maps are cramped, the quests are underdesigned, the voice cast is of about 2 people, This is just an attempt to mislead people into buying the under developed game.
This game is made up of a random assortment of assets from unity which clash together and the design lacks any fluidity. again the voice cast has no emotion and just modified to sound like different people. maps give you no indication on where to go, there are broken menus everywhere, and then they have to go attack a boss surrounded by an army that you CANNOT defeat on your own, I cannot seem to level up set skills stats or ANYTHING else, as either menus do not open or in fact do not close. You can use the NPC's to kill the boss and as I got past the boss there is a path with an invisible wall. No way to continue... I keep seeing the word, "open world", you do not know what that means, with all the walls invisible and unable to venture anywhere you want, this is as far from it as you can get.

The Dev's created a mash up of unity assets in a blender and tried to call it a game. This is NOT Early access, this is is a product NOT READY for the masses in ANYWAY, with all the bugs and glitches and issues, these should be ones you found and fixed BEFORE early access was allowed...
---

Edit: 5/30/17
This "developer" is using multiple accounts to downvote or dislike any review or video that gives a bad review.

---

This game is almost UNPLAYABLE I kept running off into the distance, the tutorial was worthless for gameplay or story line, I really kept trying to play this but the voices are bad the graphics are bad the textures are bad... I really tried to get into then then I randomly turned into a chicken with gibberish on my screen and pretty much broke the game more... you can move while in cut scenes and since it keeps making me run I run off into no where and have to make my way back. I couldn't keep track of the story as NPCs talked over each other and again... THE voices are so badly done at one point the old mans voice dropped so low I swear he was about to drop a beat on me. For anyone who doubts this experience Here is the Video I made of my experience.

https://youtu.be/qbIpOzfVZPw
